nodes.label: Default Android round launcher icon (xhdpi, 96x96)
nodes.rationale: The image is the stock Android SDK placeholder icon (white Android robot head on a teal grid circle), not an OPC-branded asset. Its presence across all density buckets indicates the mobile app's Android launcher icon has not yet been customized with OPC branding — a placeholder left from project scaffolding.

nodes.label: Round launcher icon density variant pattern
nodes.rationale: This file is the xhdpi (96x96 px) variant of ic_launcher_round.webp in the standard Android mipmap density-bucket layout (hdpi/mdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi). Android resolves the correct asset at runtime by device screen density; round icons are used by launchers that request circular icon masks.
